thread:
incident-bot: PAGER @oncall: High error + latency on /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 (alert A-2378)
sam: ack. jumping in — dashboards show sustained p95 p99 latency spike starting ~01:07:10 UTC and a concurrent increase in 502/504s
sam: quick checks: app-router p95 up 3x, downstream inference pool showing backpressure on model-worker pool
rui: I'm seeing 504 gateway_timeout with upstream=embedding-worker and error=read_timeout in logs
megan: increasing log ingest sample to 100% for 5m to capture full context and turning on full-header capture for router logs
infra-bot: adhoc metric query: sum(rate(http_requests_total{path="/v1/embeddings",status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (host) -> host-a: 0.2, host-b: 9.6, host-c: 0.1
sam: host-b is the hotspot. can someone paste a raw 502/504 line? need request_id + upstream latency
carlos: raw example:
```log
2026-03-15T01:08:23Z level=error svc=router path=/v1/embeddings status=504 request_id=req_aa12 upstream=embedding-worker-17 upstream_time=30.12s err="read_timeout"
```
rui: trend: a lot of long upstream_time values >20s, and many lines missing traceparent header — I suspect header drop at edge LB or sampling agent
megan: observability gap: internal ES ingest pipeline shows a drop for router logs between 01:06:50-01:09:00, indexer returned 400s for ~12k docs (schema mismatch) — may have silently dropped some fields like request_id
infra-bot: note: alert rule uses label "svc" but logs index uses "service" in some hosts — dashboards underreport errors when query uses svc label
sam: mitigation actions: scaling embedding-worker-17 pool 4 -> 10, adding circuit-breaker for long requests (>20s) at router, temporarily bumping request timeout to 40s for retries to avoid cascades
carlos: rolling restart of indexer-ingest-2 to clear transient schema failure, and re-ingest dropped logs from buffer if available
rui: started a controlled replay: replaying 01:05-01:10 traffic to staging workers to reproduce the high upstream_time and to validate circuit-breaker thresholds
megan: capture timeline so far: 01:06:55 ingress spike, 01:07:10 p95/p99 ascent, 01:07:40 first 5xx surge, 01:08:10 indexer schema errors begin, 01:08:23 peak 504s, 01:09:00 scale + restart actions kick in, 01:10:45 errors decline
sam: customer impact: some batches of embeddings returned 502/504 leading to client retries and duplicate compute cost for customers using bulk requests. Adding support blurb and mitigation note in status page
carlos: export job: copying raw 01:05-01:12 logs to s3://redwood-incidents/1972003456/raw-logs and saving indexer error dump to same bucket
megan: gaps to include in RCA: missing traceparent/request_id on ~30% of error lines, indexer schema mismatch caused partial ingest loss, dashboard label inconsistency (svc vs service), traces sampling at edge set to 0.1 by default (too low for bursty failures)
infra-bot: retention policy check -> logs retention for hot index is 48h; noticed the ingest buffer only retains 6h by default — risk for delayed debugging
sam: handoff: I'll monitor 20m then hand to @oncall-next (rui). Tasks for RCA: 1) collect full replays & traces, 2) reconcile ingest schema and add schema-forwarding test, 3) normalize labels across hosts, 4) increase edge trace sampling on critical paths
rui: ack. I'll own RCA doc and postmortem. adding follow-ups: automated ingest failure alert, add preflight schema check on indexer deploys, tighten circuit-breaker config for long upstream_time
carlos: adding a runbook note: always export raw logs before rotating index or cleanup when an incident affects request metadata
megan: dropping a few query snippets for RCA:
```
# logs missing request ids
GET /_search?q=service:router AND status:500 OR status:504 | fields request_id, traceparent
# metric spike by host
sum by (host) (rate(http_requests_total{path="/v1/embeddings",status=~"5.."}[1m]))
```
sam: incident status -> mitigated (5xx < 1% and p99 back to baseline) at 01:10:45 UTC. leaving alerts at normal; will retain increased sampling for 2h to populate traces
megan: following up: will open infra PR to align ingest schemas and update dashboards, and add test for header propagation across LB->router->indexer
rui: thanks team. handover complete. RCA doc link will be posted once initial timeline + raw excerpts are in. :white_check_mark:
